page_title: RMA 3-2 BAR | Real Madrid v Barcelona 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' An attempted cross from Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is cleared.
90+4' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner.
90+4' 14:13 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90+4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Andriy Lunin punches the ball away.
90+1' 3 - 2 Goal! Lucas Vazquez provides Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort under the bar. 3:2.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' One of the players from Real Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
87' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes a direct free kick.
87' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
86' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
85' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Cesar Soto Grado interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
84' Fermin Lopez almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
83' Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to Luka Modric (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.
82' That will be all from Vinicius Junior who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Joselu (Real Madrid).
81' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
78' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is about to take a corner kick.
78' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

77' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Cesar Soto Grado with no other option than to blow for a foul. Barcelona will take a free kick near the side line.
76' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen was alert and made a comfortable save.
75' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
75' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eder Militao (Real Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Rodrygo can be given a rest.
73' 2 - 2 It's 2:2! Vinicius Junior feeds Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
71' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Toni Kroos is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Eduardo Camavinga as he is replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
69' 1 - 2 Goal! Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:2.
69' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Andriy Lunin easily deals with the threat.
67' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
66' Surely that's handball by one of the Barcelona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
66' The corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
66' A snap shot from distance by Luka Modric (Real Madrid) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
64' Xavi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joao Felix (Barcelona) replacing Raphinha.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Lewandowski trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
63' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) runs into space on the edge of the box and tries a curler that drifts well wide of the left post.
62' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
61' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
56' A poor finish by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) as he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
54' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to find Lucas Vazquez with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
53' The ball is cleared after Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
53' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
51' Great teamplay by Barcelona as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
50' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
48' The attendance for today's match is 77981.
47' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Andriy Lunin.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Xavi gives a chance to Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) and Andreas Christensen is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' Xavi is forced to make a change. Frenkie de Jong is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pedri (Barcelona).
45+3' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+2' Rodrygo is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
45' Barcelona are awarded a mid-range free kick.
45' Poor challenge! Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle.
44' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
44' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
43' Real Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
40' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
39' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
38' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andriy Lunin, who smothers the ball. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
37' The foul by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was seen by Cesar Soto Grado who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
37' Federico Valverde nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Rodrygo (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
34' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Raphinha (Barcelona), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
34' Barcelona are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
33' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Cesar Soto Grado had an easy-decision to make.
31' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
30' After what seems an eternity, referee Cesar Soto Grado decides NO GOAL for Barcelona after the VAR review! Play to continue.
29' Barcelona score a goal, but referee Cesar Soto Grado has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!

28' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom right corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Andriy Lunin with a fabulous save.
28' Barcelona will take a corner kick.
27' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
25' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky!
25' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) steps up to send the ball in.
24' Raphinha (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
22' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Toni Kroos (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
22' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' 64:36 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
18' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Marc-Andre ter Stegen no chance!
17' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

16' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Cesar Soto Grado signals. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Real Madrid are awarded a penalty.
16' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' Real Madrid restart play with a quick free kick.
16' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) and blew his whistle.
14' Barcelona take a short corner kick.
14' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Andriy Lunin thwarted him with a fabulous save.
13' Toni Kroos finds the head of Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies past the left post. Unlucky!
13' We are about to witness a very dangerous free kick from the edge of the box! Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) will be the one to show us his shooting technique.
9' It looks like Raphinha (Barcelona) saw red with that tackle. Cesar Soto Grado won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
8' Luka Modric slides a brilliant pass into Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar.
7' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

6' 0 - 1 Raphinha sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Andreas Christensen (Barcelona), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 0:1.
5' Raphinha (Barcelona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
4' Wasted effort! Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
3' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado will supervise the game today.
